targets.direct_cause_statement: All eight target families have attested independent reduced-scale data and runnable paper-scale contracts, but the full paper-size Monte Carlo campaign has not been executed.
targets.root_cause_statement: The accepted feature-level observables are closed by current numerical and attestation evidence. The remaining strict-lifecycle gap is an unexecuted paper-scale campaign, not a demonstrated code defect or a proven external compute blocker.
targets.next_discriminating_test: Benchmark one frozen paper-scale shard per target on the institute high-CPU profile, then run or resume the unchanged sharded campaign only if the measured resource envelope is acceptable.
